vector_memory.semantic_summary: MCPBridge acts as a critical service layer component, managing persistent, bidirectional connections to external Machine Control Protocol (MCP) servers. It abstracts complex I/O streaming into a unified 'Gateway' tool accessible to the main AI agent (JARVIS). Its primary role is to manage connection lifecycles, fetch server-specific tool schemas, and execute commands via a standardized interface.
